Check a stocking size

Select a leg and enter its measurements in centimetres.

Where to measure

Ankle
Measure around the narrowest point above the ankle bone.
Calf
Measure around the widest point.
Length
Stand barefoot with your foot flat. Measure from the floor to two finger widths below the crease behind the knee.

A soft, non-stretch fabric tape also works. Keep it snug and level.

Camera calibration target

Print at actual size (100%). Use a ruler to check the rectangle is 100 mm wide and 150 mm high. Mount this page upright on a rigid flat surface.

Knee-high stocking fitting tape

Print at actual size (100%). Check the 10 cm line against a ruler. Cut out the two strips and butt the two 25 cm ends together. Tape the join on the back.

Record each leg separately. Measure the narrowest ankle above the ankle bone, the widest calf, and the floor-to-cuff length.
